gameDescriptionHtml:
Barista Simulator is a very realistic single player barista coffee simulation game. The game allows you to experience what Barista makes. Get ready to work with coffee machines. You can make a wide variety of coffees and you must be able to upgrade your machines to unlock new coffee recipes. Just some of the coffees you can make are Filter coffee, Latte, Cappuccino, Espresso, Mocha, Americano and Ice coffees.

The customers coming to your shop will want various coffees and you should improve your machines to make the coffees they want.

It’s your choice to make your own specialty coffee blend, but first make sure your customers are happy with it.

Game Features

  • Espresso Machines, Grinders, Milk Frothers, Ice Makers, Shakers, Mixers all real machines.
  • Manage your own coffee shop in every detail.
  • Shop items and shop management system that can be upgraded in-game.
  • Character Skills upgradable.
  • Cafe Skills upgradable.
  • Complete stock control and cargo system.
  • Detailed complete cafe decoration system and dynamic temperature system.
  • Do not forget to pay bills at the time!
  • How you treat customers who are dissatisfied with their coffee is entirely up to you. (Even beat them.)
  • Wide variety of coffee recipes. (Americano, Latte, Cappuccino, Espresso, Tripplo, Doppio and much more)
